summary: Prudential plc filed a Form 6-K to provide notice of its 2026 Annual General Meeting scheduled for 28 May 2026. The meeting will be held in Hong Kong and online via Lumi platform. The filing includes a Notice of Meeting and sample proxy card, available on the company's website and the UK National Storage Mechanism. This is a routine regulatory disclosure for a foreign private issuer. No special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other event-driven corporate action is present. The filing is purely informational regarding the annual shareholder meeting.
